ei.subject: 영어1 동아(박용예)
ei.title: Tips and Tricks for a Healthier Digital Life

fullPassage:
Cathy is a gamer who runs a popular channel. One day, she found that her channel had been suspended. She was confused until she realized she had used background music in her videos without permission. Like Cathy, many content creators unknowingly violate copyright laws by embedding copyrighted material such as music, images, or video clips in their content. To avoid this, check all the components of your content and make sure they do not include copyrighted material. If they do, contact the owner for permission, or replace or remove the material. Another option is utilizing material with a Creative Commons (CC) license. CC licenses allow creators to share their work under specific conditions marked by the following symbols: BY (credit the creator), NC (non-commercial use only), ND (no changes allowed), and SA (share under the same license).

Alex is a fashion design student who loves online shopping. Recently, she noticed that the items recommended to her were always the same style. She had fallen into a filter bubble. Algorithms on websites and apps filter content based on your past purchases, likes, and search history. While this may seem convenient, it reinforces your existing beliefs and preferences, limiting your exposure to diverse perspectives. To check if you are in a filter bubble, try logging out and comparing the content you see with what you normally see when logged in. To manage filter bubbles, regularly clear your cookies and be cautious about sharing personal information online without careful consent.

Min is a high school student who loves posting photos on social media. Lately, he has become obsessed with the number of likes his posts receive. When his posts get few likes, he feels shame, rejection, and anxiety. Min is not alone. Many people, especially teenagers, unconsciously compare themselves to others on social media. This can make them feel inferior, harm their self-esteem, and even lead to depression. To use social media more mindfully, consider the following guidelines. First, set time limits and take regular breaks. Second, remember that social media is a networking tool, not a competition. Third, keep in mind that what people post online shows only the highlights of their lives, not the full story. Finally, instead of feeling envious, use other people’s achievements as motivation to pursue your own goals.

questions.passage: Cathy is a gamer who runs a popular channel. One day, she found that her channel __________. She was confused until she realized she had used background music in her videos without permission.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 채널이 정지당한 것(수동)이므로 과거완료 수동태 had been suspended가 적절하다. "채널이 정지되었다는 것을 알았다"
det.analysis:
✅ ③ had been suspended: 과거완료 수동태 → found보다 앞선 시점에 정지됨
❌ ① suspending: 능동 분사 → 채널이 정지하는 주체가 아님
❌ ② suspended: 과거분사 단독 → be동사 필요
❌ ④ has suspended: 현재완료 능동 → 시제·태 모두 부적절
det.tip: found(과거) + that절 → 더 이전 시점의 수동 사건 = had been p.p. (과거완료 수동태)

questions.passage: Like Cathy, many content creators unknowingly violate copyright laws by __________ copyrighted material such as music, images, or video clips in their content.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 embedding이 적절하다. "저작권이 있는 자료를 삽입함으로써"
det.analysis:
✅ ② embedding: 전치사 by + 동명사 → "~함으로써"
❌ ① embed: 원형 → 전치사 뒤 불가
❌ ③ to embed: to부정사 → by 뒤 불가
❌ ④ embedded: 과거분사 → 전치사 뒤 부적절
det.tip: by + ~ing: ~함으로써 (수단/방법을 나타내는 전치사 + 동명사)

questions.passage: To check if you are in a filter bubble, try logging out and comparing the content you see with __________ you normally see when logged in.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사 what이 적절하다. "로그인했을 때 보통 보는 것(= the things that)"
det.analysis:
✅ ③ what: 선행사 포함 관계대명사 → "~하는 것"
❌ ① which: 선행사 필요 → 앞에 선행사 없음
❌ ② that: 선행사 필요
❌ ④ where: 관계부사 → see의 목적어 필요
det.tip: what = the thing(s) that/which: 선행사가 없을 때 "~하는 것"을 나타냄

questions.passage: Many people, especially teenagers, unconsciously compare themselves to others on social media. This can make them __________ inferior, harm their self-esteem, and even lead to depression.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사역동사 make + 목적어(them) + 동사원형 구조이므로 feel이 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① feel: make + O + 동사원형 → "그들이 열등감을 느끼게 하다"
❌ ② to feel: 사역동사 뒤 to부정사 불가
❌ ③ feeling: 현재분사 → 사역동사 구문에 부적절
❌ ④ felt: 과거형/과거분사 → 동사원형이 필요
❌ ⑤ feels: 3인칭 단수 → 원형이 필요
det.tip: 사역동사 make/let/have + 목적어 + 동사원형: ~가 …하게 하다

questions.passage: Algorithms on websites and apps filter content ①<u>based</u> on your past purchases, likes, and search history. While this may seem convenient, it ②<u>reinforcing</u> your existing beliefs and preferences. To manage filter bubbles, regularly ③<u>clear</u> your cookies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~③ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② reinforcing → reinforces: 주어 it에 대한 본동사가 필요하므로 현재분사가 아닌 동사 reinforces가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ② reinforcing(현재분사) → reinforces(동사): 주어 it의 본동사가 필요
✅ ① based: 과거분사 → "~에 기반하여" 올바름
✅ ③ clear: 명령문 동사원형 → 올바름
det.tip: 주어 + 본동사: 분사(~ing/p.p.)는 단독으로 본동사 역할 불가 → 동사 형태 필요

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: "she had used background music in her videos without permission" → Cathy의 채널은 배경 음악 저작권 문제로 정지되었다.

ch: Cathy의 채널은 배경 음악 때문에 정지되었다.

✅ ① fashion design student → 일치
✅ ② past purchases, likes, search history → 일치
✅ ④ logging out and comparing → 일치
det.tip: 불일치 문제: "limiting"(제한) vs "늘려준다"(증가) — 핵심 동사의 방향성 확인

ch: 필터 버블은 과거 구매, 좋아요, 검색 기록에 기반한다.

questions.passage: Like Cathy, many content creators unknowingly violate copyright laws by embedding __________ such as music, images, or video clips in their content. To avoid this, check all the components of your content and make sure they do not include __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 음악, 이미지, 비디오 클립과 같은 저작권이 있는 자료(copyrighted material)를 삽입함으로써 저작권법을 위반한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② copyrighted material: 뒤의 "such as music, images, or video clips"과 일치
❌ ① original content: 자신의 창작물 → 위반 대상 아님
❌ ③ free software: 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ personal data: 저작권과 무관
det.tip: 빈칸 뒤 "such as"가 핵심 단서 → 음악/이미지/클립 = 저작권 자료

questions.passage: Alex is a fashion design student who loves online shopping. Recently, she noticed that the items recommended to her were always the same style. She had fallen into a __________. Algorithms on websites and apps filter content based on your past purchases, likes, and search history.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 항상 같은 스타일만 추천받는 상황 + 알고리즘이 콘텐츠를 필터링 → 필터 버블(filter bubble)에 빠졌다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② filter bubble: 알고리즘의 필터링 → 같은 스타일만 추천 = 필터 버블
❌ ① comfort zone: 비유적 표현이지만 본문 용어와 불일치
❌ ③ social network: 소셜 네트워크 자체가 아님
❌ ④ digital footprint: 디지털 발자국은 다른 개념
det.tip: filter bubble: 알고리즘이 사용자 맞춤 콘텐츠만 보여주어 다양성이 차단되는 현상

questions.passage: To use social media more mindfully, consider the following guidelines. First, set time limits and take regular breaks. Second, remember that social media is a networking tool, not a competition. Third, keep in mind that what people post online shows only the __________ of their lives, not the full story.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사람들이 온라인에 올리는 것은 삶의 하이라이트(highlights)만 보여줄 뿐, 전체 이야기가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① highlights: "not the full story"와 대비 → 좋은 부분만 보여줌
❌ ② struggles: 고군분투 → "not the full story"와 논리적 대비 불성립
❌ ③ secrets: 비밀 → 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ failures: 실패 → SNS에 올리는 내용과 반대
det.tip: highlights vs full story: SNS는 삶의 좋은 면만 보여줌 → 비교하지 말 것

questions.passage: Copyright __________ (violate) is a serious issue for content creators. Cathy is a gamer who runs a popular channel. One day, she found that her channel had been suspended because she had used background music without permission.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: violate(동사) → violation(명사): "Copyright violation" = 저작권 위반. 명사 자리이므로 명사형으로 변환.
det.analysis:
violate(동사) → violation(명사)
Copyright + 명사: 복합명사 구조
Copyright violation = 저작권 위반
det.tip: violate → violation / create → creation / educate → education — -ate → -ation 명사 변환

det.korean: unconscious(형용사) → unconsciously(부사): 동사 compare를 수식하는 부사가 필요. "무의식적으로 비교하다"

동사 compare를 수식하는 부사 필요
unconsciously compare = 무의식적으로 비교하다
det.tip: 형용사 + -ly = 부사: unconscious → unconsciously / considerable → considerably

det.korean: 본문: "it reinforces your existing beliefs and preferences, limiting your exposure to diverse perspectives" → 필터 버블은 다양한 관점을 제한한다. "다양한 관점을 발견하게 도와준다"는 False.
det.analysis: ❌ False: "limiting your exposure to diverse perspectives" → 다양한 관점을 제한함 ≠ 도와줌
det.tip: reinforces existing beliefs + limiting exposure → 필터 버블은 기존 믿음을 강화하고 다양성을 제한

questions.passage: Min is a high school student who loves posting photos on social media. Lately, he has become obsessed with the number of likes his posts receive. When his posts get few likes, he feels shame, rejection, and anxiety. Min is not alone. Many people, especially teenagers, unconsciously compare themselves to others on social media. This can make them feel inferior, harm their self-esteem, and even lead to depression. To use social media more mindfully, consider the following guidelines. First, set time limits and take regular breaks. Second, remember that social media is a networking tool, not a competition. Third, keep in mind that what people post online shows only the highlights of their lives, not the full story. Finally, instead of feeling envious, use other people’s achievements as motivation to pursue your own goals.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Comparing oneself to others on social media can harm self-esteem and lead to depression."

det.korean: "This can make them feel inferior, harm their self-esteem, and even lead to depression." → 소셜 미디어에서 비교하면 자존감 저하와 우울증으로 이어질 수 있다. → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: 본문 원문과 진술이 정확히 일치
det.tip: harm self-esteem + lead to depression: SNS 비교의 부정적 결과

questions.passage: Cathy is a gamer who runs a popular channel. One day, she found that her channel had been suspended. She was confused until she realized she had used background music in her videos without permission. Like Cathy, many content creators unknowingly violate copyright laws by embedding copyrighted material such as music, images, or video clips in their content. To avoid this, check all the components of your content and make sure they do not include copyrighted material. If they do, contact the owner for permission, or replace or remove the material. Another option is utilizing material with a Creative Commons (CC) license. CC licenses allow creators to share their work under specific conditions marked by the following symbols: BY (credit the creator), NC (non-commercial use only), ND (no changes allowed), and SA (share under the same license).
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"A Creative Commons license with the ND symbol allows users to modify and adapt the original work."

det.korean: 본문: "ND (no changes allowed)" → ND는 변경 금지를 의미한다. "수정하고 각색할 수 있다"는 False.
det.analysis: ❌ False: ND = No Derivatives = 변경 금지 → modify/adapt 불가
det.tip: CC 라이선스 기호: BY(저작자표시), NC(비영리), ND(변경금지), SA(동일조건공유)
